---
title: "Module Catalog"
description: "Concise, searchable reference to camtrapReport modules across the Data Status Check, Global, and EOW reports."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Module Catalog}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---
<style>

.cr-catalog { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif; color:#263b35; width:100%; max-width:1050px; }
.cr-catalog, .cr-catalog * {box-sizing:border-box}
.cr-catalog a {color:#006b58}
.cr-catalog .subtitle {color:#64766e;margin:0 0 22px;line-height:1.6;font-size:0.96rem}
.cr-catalog .shell {border:1px solid #dde8e2;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.cr-catalog .toolbar {padding:20px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2ebe6}
.cr-catalog .tabs,.cr-catalog .profiles {display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:9px 0}
.cr-catalog .tab,.cr-catalog .pf {cursor:pointer;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #dae7df;background:#f4f8f5;border-radius:8px;color:#31594b;font-weight:600;font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.4}
.cr-catalog .tab.active,.cr-catalog .pf.active {background:#003b32;border-color:#003b32;color:#fff}
.cr-catalog .search {width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #d5e2da;border-radius:8px;font:inherit;margin:12px 0 0}
.cr-catalog .helper {color:#697e73;font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 0}
.cr-catalog .sectionhead {padding:12px 22px;background:#f4f8f5;color:#46695a;border-bottom:1px solid #dde8e2;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.6px}
.cr-catalog .entry {padding:16px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5ede7}
.cr-catalog .entry:last-child {border-bottom:0}
.cr-catalog .entry h3 {margin:0;color:#075d4c;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700}
.cr-catalog .row {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.cr-catalog .tags {display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cr-catalog .tag {display:inline-block;font-size:11px;background:#edf5ef;color:#536e60;border-radius:99px;padding:4px 8px}
.cr-catalog .entry p {font-size:.87rem;color:#53685e;line-height:1.55;margin:7px 0 0}
.cr-catalog .details {margin-top:12px;border:1px solid #e0eae3;background:#f8fbf8;padding:12px 15px;border-radius:8px}
.cr-catalog .details p {margin:6px 0}
.cr-catalog .details strong {color:#294338}
.cr-catalog .appendix {border-left:4px solid #80af96;margin-left:18px}
.cr-catalog .notice {font-size:12px;color:#64786b;margin:13px 21px 17px;line-height:1.6}
.cr-catalog .hidden {display:none}
@media(max-width:600px){.cr-catalog .entry{padding:14px}.cr-catalog .row{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.cr-catalog .toolbar{padding:13px}}
</style>

<div class="cr-catalog"><p class="subtitle">Explore the Data Status Check and Ecological Report modules, including their scientific purposes, analytical methods, configuration, and source definitions. Modules follow the order specified by each Analytical Profile.</p><div class="shell"><div class="toolbar"><div class="tabs"><button class="tab" data-kind="status">Data Status Check</button><button class="tab active" data-kind="report">Ecological Report</button></div><div class="profiles" id="cr-profiles"></div><input class="search" id="cr-search" placeholder="Search modules, methods, parameters, packages…"/><p class="helper" id="cr-count"></p></div><div id="cr-entries"></div><p class="notice">Methodological terminology describes the supplied YAML and supporting R source. Rendering packages are not presented as estimators. Some parameters are inherited from internal R functions rather than exposed as user-adjustable module settings.</p></div></div>

no estimator invoked by YAML", "declaredPackages": "base", "source": "https://github.com/spatialecology/camtrapReport/blob/main/inst/statusSections/temporal.yml", "yamlPresent": true, "profile": ["EOW"], "parent": "appendix_eow", "codeLength": 3955}, {"id": "availability", "kind": "status", "title": "Chapter 2: Data Availability", "category": "Diagnostics", "summary": "Tabulates completeness of required and supporting data elements.", "method": "Field-level completion/status summary, including locations, deployments, observations and media.", "settings": "Camtrap DP core tables", "methodPackages": "None", "declaredPackages": "base", "source": "https://github.com/spatialecology/camtrapReport/blob/main/inst/statusSections/availability.yml", "yamlPresent": true, "profile": ["EOW"], "parent": "appendix_eow", "codeLength": 6351}]}};let kind='report',profile='Global';let term='';const elem=document.getElementById('cr-entries');function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,x=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;','"':'&quot;'}[x]));}
function render(){document.querySelectorAll('.cr-catalog .tab').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.kind===kind));let prof=document.getElementById('cr-profiles');prof.innerHTML=kind==='status'?'':(['Global','EOW'].map(x=>`<button class="pf ${profile===x?'active':''}" data-profile="${x}">${x}</button>`).join(''));prof.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{profile=b.dataset.profile;render()});let arr=kind==='status'?DATA.status:DATA.report[profile];arr=arr.filter(x=>(x.title+' '+x.id+' '+x.summary+' '+x.method+' '+x.settings+' '+x.methodPackages).toLowerCase().includes(term));document.getElementById('cr-count').textContent=arr.length+' sections · '+(kind==='status'?'Data Status Check':profile+' profile')+(term?' · filtered':'');let result='';arr.forEach((x,i)=>{if(x.parent==='appendix_eow'&&kind==='report'&&profile==='EOW'&&i>0&&arr[i-1].parent!=='appendix_eow')result+='<div class="sectionhead">APPENDIX — REUSED DATA STATUS CHECK MODULES</div>';result+=`<article class="entry ${x.parent==='appendix_eow'?'appendix':''}"><div class="row"><h3>${esc(x.title)}</h3><div class="tags"><span class="tag">${esc(x.category)}</span>${x.profile.map(p=>`<span class="tag">${esc(p)}</span>`).join('')}${x.kind==='status'&&kind==='report'?'<span class="tag">Data Status Check source</span>':''}</div></div><p>${esc(x.summary)}</p><p><a href="${esc(x.source)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View module YAML ↗</a></p></article>`});elem.innerHTML=result||'<p class="notice">No modules found.</p>'}
document.querySelectorAll('.cr-catalog .tab').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{kind=b.dataset.kind;render()});document.getElementById('cr-search').oninput=e=>{term=e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();render()};render();
</script>
